summary: Iteration 32 tested Zoho Books CMS creds + live financials fallback, manual review invite button, and IMAP mailbox sync-now / ingested-log. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (Zoho GET shape, PUT persistence + empty-fields-preserve + test endpoint 400 on invalid creds + financials mocked fallback; manual invite creates review_invites doc with manual=true and appears in invite-log; mailboxes sync-now with 0 returns zeros, add creates mailbox, duplicate email → 409, delete works). All frontend flows pass: ZohoBooksCard renders with 4 password inputs + dc select + save + test (test disabled while unconfigured, enabled after save, returns '✗ Refresh token exchange faalde: Zoho responded without access_token' — expected); ManualReviewInviteRow sends invite and 'Handmatig' badge appears in log; MailboxesAdmin hides sync-now when 0 mailboxes, shows it after add, INBOX folder rendered in row, sync-now returned '1 mailbox(en) gescand · 0 nieuw · 0 gekoppeld' (imap.invalid.example silently fails to resolve inside sync_all, error swallowed → 0 counters — acceptable). Cleanup done: test Zoho creds deleted and test mailbox row removed so the 60s poller doesn't spam a fake host.
action_items: Minor: React warning 'Encountered two children with the same key' fires on /admin/reviews and /admin/mailboxes (see AdminDashboard.jsx line ~3113 area — likely a .map() using a non-unique key such as l.project_id/email). Not blocking but should be fixed to prevent hydration/duplication artefacts.
Minor hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — some <select><option> markup contains a nested span. Search AdminDashboard.jsx for <option> children.

Copy nit: after saving Zoho creds the card does show configured state (last4 populated) but there is no explicit textual 'Live' badge — the review-request phrasing 'status badge switches to Live' does not match the actual UI (which relies on the test button becoming enabled). Either add a Live/Configured badge next to the Zoho card title, or update the spec — currently a user has to notice the Test button un-greying to know the save worked.
critical_code_review_comments: test_zoho_books_conn (server.py ~2767) swallows the 'no access_token in response' path as 'Refresh token exchange faalde: Zoho responded without access_token' — good defensive handling, but the same _books_access_token() also raises RuntimeError which is caught → 400. Consider returning the Zoho error body (error_description) verbatim so admins can distinguish invalid_client vs invalid_code.

PUT /admin/integrations/zoho-books treats None as 'keep existing' (nice) but treats empty string '' as 'overwrite to empty and re-encrypt' — this means the admin cannot clear a single field without reset. Not blocking for MVP but worth documenting.

imap_sync_all runs synchronously inside asyncio.to_thread; a hanging IMAP host (imap.invalid.example) can block up to socket default timeout (~75s). Recommend imaplib socket timeout ≤10s to keep POST /admin/mailboxes/sync-now snappy.

AdminDashboard.jsx has grown to 3151 lines — MailboxesAdmin, ZohoBooksCard, ManualReviewInviteRow are all still inline. Extract to /components/admin/*.jsx (previous testing agent flagged the same for UserDocumentsPanel).
Duplicate-key React warning (line ~3113) is a real bug — will cause rows to be omitted from lists once counts exceed uniqueness of the current key.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily inserted db.integrations {_id:'zoho_books'} with dummy Fernet-encrypted creds and one review_invites doc (manual=true, email=test@example.com). Zoho creds row deleted after testing. Mailbox row also deleted (imap.invalid.example) so the background poller does not spam DNS. review_invites doc left in place (harmless log entry).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints in this iteration: GET/PUT/POST /api/admin/integrations/zoho-books[/test]; POST /api/admin/reviews/send-invite; GET /api/admin/reviews/invite-log; POST /api/admin/mailboxes/sync-now; GET /api/admin/mailboxes/ingested. UI testids added: cms-zoho-books-card + zoho-input-{client-id,client-secret,refresh-token,org-id,dc} + zoho-save + zoho-test + zoho-test-result; cms-manual-invite-row + cms-manual-invite-{email,project,invoice,send}; mailbox-sync-now (only rendered when items.length>0), mailbox-sync-result, mailbox-add-btn, mailbox-form, mailbox-input-{label,email,host,port,username,password,folder,ssl}, mailbox-submit, mailbox-row-{id}, mailbox-delete-{id}, mailbox-ingest-log. Zoho DC pattern is '^(eu|com|in|com\.au)$' — 'us' is rejected with 422. Financials endpoint always falls back to mocked when creds are unset OR when the live fetch throws, so it is safe to leave dummy creds in place.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in the scoped features. Test iteration failure during dev was self-inflicted (invalid 'us' dc code); fixed in the test file by using 'com'.
